# QR encoder

qrcodegen.js comes from Project Nayuki: https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js

MIT license is retained in the source header. Downloaded 2026-11-10.
SHA-256: 2511BC17F40A3C41D4A0578995DB956B38997334D3D20113A5D4DC5C49C69480

This file runs locally in the browser; no recipient or payment amount is sent to an external QR service.
The independent QR decoder in tests/vendor is test-only jsQR under Apache-2.0; its license and pinned source commit are retained there.
